transformation.operation: x_native=x_sumo-netOffset_x; y_native=y_sumo-netOffset_y; pyproj Transformer.from_crs(source, EPSG:4326, always_xy=True)
transformation.pipeline: proj=pipeline step inv proj=utm zone=55 ellps=WGS84 step proj=unitconvert xy_in=rad xy_out=deg

geometry_semantics.lane_rule: Lexicographically first lane ID, exactly as frozen road_graph_authority.py uses for physical geometry
geometry_semantics.point_order: global zero-based per reduced directed edge in source_position order
geometry_semantics.part_index: zero-based continuous polyline part; never connect points across distinct part_index
geometry_semantics.internal_junction_connectors: Not present in ordered physical catalog; not guessed or searched. Gaps retained as separate MultiLineString parts.

endpoint_tolerance.rule: Source junction polygon maximum geodesic radius around frozen node + 5 m lane/rounding allowance

metropolitan_boundary.needed: Complete existing-snapshot OSM Greater Melbourne boundary=place relation, all member ways and their nodes; no City of Melbourne LGA substitution

land_context.needed: Complete clipped WGS84 land polygon with provenance (existing Vicmap coastal/land polygon or complete OSM coastline/land-area geometry); no inferred land-side closure

roles: ordered reduced-link to original physical edges
